floor_relief.note: Local450lbf comparison only;global floor load acceptance and finish/seal selection remain.

assembly_sequence: Fabricate collars around crossmembers before installing adjacent longitudinal seat rails.
Fit faces and top/bottom closure plates to measured HSS flat surfaces; clamp and complete exterior corner seams.
Complete perimeter end welds to available HSS flats; inspect before enclosing floor.
Trim and fit all12 affected rail segments; attach both near andfar end welds at everycollar.
Install saddles and trial seat mounts, then removable floor closeouts and hardware.

hardware_stack.bolt: SAE J429 Grade8,1/2-13x3.5 hexcap screw candidate
hardware_stack.washers: ASTM F436 Type1 hardened round each side
hardware_stack.pretension: No torque released. Qualify actual coated bolt, washers and Spiralock nut with measured torque-tension; no friction strength credit.
hardware_stack.locking: Spiralock wedge-ramp nut with compatible standard UN thread; no unverified generic nyloc substitution
hardware_stack.maintenance: Two-ended access: restrain bolt head above using3/4socket, drive nut below using3/4deep socket. Remove floor boot/closeout and support seat before loosening. Witness marks track movement but are not primary locking.

clearances.service_condition: Nominal approach cylinders require full underframe/truck check. C45 collar conflicts with baseline C5 sidebearer and must be integrated.

remaining_gates: Actual rail/crossmember corner radii and wall certificates; production joint gaps and measured floor stack
Weld procedure/access/quality and effective groove throat; welding to existing coatings prohibited
Bolted contact/prying/preload qualification, fretting and vibration retention tests
HSS local wall deformation, existing chord stress interaction, neighboring rail loads and global coach/truck loadpath
Fatigue and physical proof/overload tests using agreed accepted criteria
C5 sidebearer/collar interface and complete service-tool approach
Flush floor finish/seal selection and global floor criteria; no structural credit to cut panel edges
